infobox.usage: Unlocks the security armory on the first floor of the TerraGroup security post building on Streets of Tarkov.

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: TerraGroup security armory key (TG arm.) is a Key in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Description
sections.text: A key to TerraGroup's office security armory.

sections.heading: Key Location
sections.text:
- In Drawers
- In Jackets
- Pockets and bags of Scavs

sections.heading: Lock Location
sections.text: Security armory on the first floor of the TerraGroup security post building at Streets of Tarkov.

sections.heading: Behind the Lock
sections.text:
- Loose loot ()
- 1x Weapon box (6x6)
- 1x Weapon box (4x4)
- 1x PC block
- 2x Wooden crate
- 1x Grenade box
- 1x Weapon locker
- 2x Weapon rack (possible M4A1 Carbine variant spawn)
